titulo: Transition from bronchiole to respiratory bronchiole
descricao_original: This higher magnification image shows the epithelial changes along the transitions from bronchiole to terminal bronchiole to respiratory bronchiole. Toluidine blue, 500x
creditos_identificados: Image source: The image was taken of a slide in the Duke University collection.
